resources.string: GPU frequency, minimum and maximum limits, and automatic control.
Frequency control is unavailable. Readings are shown when the driver provides them.
Frequency steps reported by the device: %1$d

Choose a frequency reported by this device. Fixed mode can bypass software GPU thermal frequency limits. A fixed frequency can increase power use and temperature. The setting applies while the GPU is active; the GPU can still power down when idle.
Release manual GPU frequency limits and fixed mode, and let the system choose the frequency again.
A restart restores automatic GPU control. These controls do not change CPU settings. Requested and effective frequency limits are shown separately; the current frequency comes from the driver.
The requested GPU control is unavailable. Reopen this page and try again.
This GPU driver does not support the requested control.
That frequency is no longer reported by the device. Choose one of the currently available values.
The GPU driver rejected the change. The app attempted to restore the previous setting.
The requested GPU setting could not be confirmed. The app attempted to restore the previous setting.
%1$s The previous GPU setting could not be restored. Restore automatic control or restart the phone.

Choose a minimum and maximum from the frequencies reported by this device. The GPU can scale within the effective range and power down when idle. A high minimum can override some software thermal limits and increase heat and power use.
The minimum frequency cannot exceed the maximum.
Another controller changed the GPU settings. Its setting was left unchanged.
Requested limits are your settings. Effective limits are the range currently applied by the driver after combining all controllers.
A fixed GPU frequency is active. Applying a range releases fixed mode and lets the GPU scale between the effective limits.
